prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a parking lot collision. The patient had 18 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1159; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a low-speed collision in a parking lot with ongoing right shoulder pain and reduced range of motion. Over the course of 18 visits, care consisted of physical therapy, home exercise instruction, and as-needed anti-inflammatory medication. Treatment followed an expected progression, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms improved and function returned toward baseline. Examination findings were mixed: several provocative maneuvers and range-of-motion measurements support a shoulder soft tissue injury, while strength testing and neurological screening were within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Billed services reflect the planned course of care with no duplicate or repeated charges. At this time it remains unclear to what extent the present complaints are attributable to the collision versus other causes, and further imaging correlation may be helpful for that determination. Continued home exercise and reassessment are recommended, with return precautions reviewed.
